history.period: Hari mandir inaugurated 1994; shikharbaddh Akshardham built early 2000s (exact consecration date unverified)
history.summary: This is the BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham at Vaishali Nagar (opp. Chitrakoot Marg, Sector 9), Jaipur - NOT the Delhi Akshardham (consecrated 6 Nov 2005) and NOT the new BAPS Akshardham at Jodhpur (Kaliberi Sursagar, pran pratishtha Sep 2025). Satsang was sown by Shastriji Maharaj; a hari mandir was inaugurated in Jaipur in 1994, and Pramukh Swami Maharaj wished for a shikharbaddh mandir here, so construction began in the Pink City alongside the Delhi Akshardham project. The sandstone-and-white-marble complex has a golden-domed central shikhar with four smaller shrines (symbolising the four Vedas per travel guides - verify), carved scenes from the life of Lord Swaminarayan, gardens, a library and a museum; entry is free and photography inside is not permitted.

name: BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir, Jaipur
town_description: Jaipur, the Pink City, is the capital of Rajasthan - a major tourist hub of palaces, forts and temples, well connected by air, rail and national highways.

travel.road: In Vaishali Nagar off Ajmer Road (NH-48, the Delhi-Jaipur highway corridor); city buses, autos and taxis (verify).
